Preciso de laudo para criar uma conta?: Do I need a medical report to create an account?
Não. O cadastro não exige laudo. A ident: No. Signing up does not require a medical report. Disclosing a neurodivergent identity on your profile and having a verification badge are optional. People without a badge can use the platform normally.
O que significa o selo de verificado?: What does the verified badge mean?
É um recurso opcional de conferência de: It is an optional check of a PDF medical report with an ICP-Brasil digital signature. The person confirms that the document is theirs and agrees to the check. The file is verified and discarded; verification records are kept, but the PDF is not.
O selo não é uma avaliação de competênci: The badge does not assess professional competence, work quality or suitability for a project. Review the person’s experience, skills, portfolio and working agreements before hiring. The account holder can remove the badge.
Posso usar a plataforma como cliente?: Can I use the platform as a client?
Sim. O cadastro oferece perfis de freela: Yes. You can sign up as a freelancer or client. Clients post projects; freelancers showcase their skills and submit proposals. The platform focuses on neurodivergent people without requiring a medical report to sign up.

O que significa a nota de clareza?: What does the clarity score mean?
A nota de clareza verifica nove critério: The clarity score checks nine criteria for completing a brief. It helps identify which information a listing contains; it does not assess a person’s competence or guarantee the project’s outcome.
Cada critério tem o mesmo peso. A porcen: Each criterion has equal weight. The percentage is the number of criteria met divided by nine, multiplied by one hundred and rounded to the nearest whole number.

Qual é o mínimo para publicar?: What is the minimum score to publish?
The system requires a score of at least 50%. Since the nine criteria have equal weight, meeting five gives a rounded score of 56%. Meeting all of them gives 100%.
O mínimo técnico não substitui uma revis: The technical minimum does not replace reviewing the text. The clearer the agreement, the easier it is for both parties to assess whether the project is a good fit.
